brief: COPY AD — REFERENCE = Fang bad-breath ad (benefits with hand-drawn arrows around a centred product, tagline under it). Build a LACALUT AKTIV HERBAL ad with THIS layout, 4
genPrompt:
COPY-AD REMAKE. The FIRST attached image is a proven, high-spending competitor Facebook ad. Recreate it as a NEAR-IDENTICAL remake for LACALUT Aktiv Herbal (German pharmacy oral care). Target: a viewer who saw both would say "same ad, different brand". KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with soft sage-free pale cream-white #F4F6F1 with a hint of forest green #1B5E3F in accents — never blue. Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words.

2.2. Product and feature callouts middle 64%.
2.3. Brand and tagline bottom 18%.

4. PRODUCT:
4.1. What it is: A white toothpaste tube with a screw-top cap.
4.2. Where it sits: Centered horizontally, occupying the middle 64% of the canvas height, with its base slightly below the vertical midline.
4.3. Approx % of canvas height: 55%.
4.4. Angle: Standing upright, slightly tilted to the right.
4.5. Lighting: Soft, even lighting from the top-left, creating subtle highlights on the tube's surface.
4.6. Shadow/reflection: A soft, diffused drop shadow directly beneath the tube, extending slightly to the right. No reflection.
4.7. Held or standing: Standing.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE:

5.2. Position: Located at the bottom right of the toothpaste tube, slightly in front of its base.
5.3. Camera angle and lens feel: Eye-level perspective, clean and sharp focus on the product, with a slightly softer focus on the mint leaves.

6. GRAPHIC DEVICES:
6.1. Stars: Five yellow (#FFD700) five-pointed stars, horizontally aligned, positioned centrally below the main headline text.
6.2. Arrows: Three thin, curved black (#222222) lines with arrowheads.
6.2.1. First arrow: Originates from below "Helps control plaque buildup" on the left, curves upwards and right, pointing to the upper left side of the toothpaste tube.
6.2.2. Second arrow: Originates from below "Supports long-term oral health" on the bottom left, curves upwards and right, pointing to the lower left side of the toothpaste tube.
6.2.3. Third arrow: Originates from below "Freshens breath naturally" on the right, curves upwards and left, pointing to the middle right side of the toothpaste tube.
6.3. Borders: The overall ad canvas has subtly rounded corners.

7. COLOUR PALETTE:

7.2. Dark grey: All primary text (#222222, approximate).
7.3. Yellow: Stars (#FFD700, approximate).
7.4. White: Toothpaste tube body (#FFFFFF).
7.5. Green: Mint leaves (various shades of natural green).

8. MOOD / FINISH:
8.1. Lighting: Bright, clean, and soft studio lighting.
8.2. Contrast: Moderate, with clear separation between elements and background.
8.3. Photo vs render: Product and mint leaves appear to be high-quality photographs. Background and text are flat graphic elements.
8.4. Any filter or grain: No visible filter, grain, or texture. The finish is smooth and polished.

CHANGES REQUESTED BY THE ART DIRECTOR (the ONLY deliberate differences from the reference — apply exactly, nothing more):
REFERENCE = Fang bad-breath ad (benefits with hand-drawn arrows around a centred product, tagline under it). Build a LACALUT AKTIV HERBAL ad with THIS layout, 4:5 portrait. TEXT SIZE BEATS IMAGE SIZE: every text line big and bold, readable at thumbnail size.
BACKGROUND: soft pale cream-white #F4F6F1 (NEVER blue, NEVER mint-green like the reference), subtle soft glow behind the product, dark forest-green-navy #12284C text and LACALUT red #C8102E highlight words.
TOP, FULL WIDTH (edge to edge with small side margins, about 30% of the height, the whole card including its bottom rows): the FIRST EXTRA attached image is a finished Facebook comment card (white card, avatar, grey bubble, bold name, FIVE GOLD STARS under the name, review text, reaction pill with count, "2w Like Reply", "View 8 replies"). Use it EXACTLY as supplied INCLUDING the bottom rows "2w  Like  Reply" and "View 8 replies" which MUST stay visible (never crop them off, never trim the card), pixel-copied, never redrawn, retyped, re-spelled - every word and element identical - only scaled up to span the full width.
MIDDLE (about 45% of the height): the attached product image (the SECOND image) = the LACALUT aktiv herbal toothpaste tube standing upright with its retail box right behind it, one pair. Place EXACTLY as supplied, centred, large, pixel-copy both packs, do NOT redraw, rotate, flip, mirror or add products. FOUR hand-drawn curved arrows in dark navy, two from labels on the LEFT and two from labels on the RIGHT, each pointing to the pack; labels BOLD dark navy, large; the words in [RED] are LACALUT red #C8102E, everything else navy:
 - Left, upper: "Powered by [RED]9 medicinal herbs[/RED]"

 - Right, upper: "Helps [RED]firm and strengthen[/RED] your gums"

BOTTOM (about 20% of the height): headline in heavy bold dark navy, centred, THREE LINES, VERY LARGE: line 1 "Don't Ignore" line 2 "Bleeding-Prone Gums." line 3 "Give Them The German Care." Leave clear breathing room between the headline and the bottom-right corner. The SECOND EXTRA attached image = the real LACALUT "100 YEARS" logo (red, lips mark, "DENTAL EXPERTISE SINCE 1925"): BOTTOM-RIGHT CORNER, small (about 18% of the canvas width), pixel-copied exactly, never redrawn, clear of the headline (no overlap). Leave a small empty space immediately to the LEFT of the logo.
NO stars row outside the review card, NO Trustpilot, NO headline above the review, NO CTA button, NO price. Remove all Fang branding and the "Tap to learn more" / FANGORAL link bar.

LACALUT PRODUCT (from the SECOND attached image onward): reproduce the real packaging EXACTLY — shape, label layout, colours, logo and wording; real proportions (a tall slim 75ml tube, never squat); only the LACALUT wordmark and variant name may read clearly, all small printed pack text stays in its ORIGINAL GERMAN and softly out of focus — NEVER legible English health words on the pack. Never invent, add or duplicate any other product, tube, box, bottle or brush. STRICT COMPLIANCE (cosmetic-only, non-negotiable): never show or write gingivitis, periodontitis, gum disease, halitosis, reverses the condition, graphic bleeding gums close-up, bleeding, reduces bleeding, stops bleeding, stops gum bleeding, gum bleeding, soothes, soothes irritation, irritation, inflammation, reduces inflammation, anti-inflammatory, heals, calms, closes gum pockets, kills bacteria, kills the bacteria, clinically proven, clinically tested, clinical trial, gum health, oral health, dental health, healthy tissue, healthy gums, dentist approved, dentist recommended; never a medical cross, never a disease or treatment claim, never "clinically proven", never a doctor endorsement unless the reference's equivalent line was explicitly rewritten by the art director. If a competitor line would breach this, keep its size/position but soften the wording to a cosmetic feel/benefit. TITLE CASE ALL HEADERS (Quan's #1 header rule, never break): the headline AND every sub-headline are written in Title Case — capitalise every significant word; small words (a, an, the, and, or, in, of, to, for, with, on, at) stay lowercase unless they are the first word. This overrides the reference ad's own casing (even if their headline is in sentence case). Body lines and fine print keep the casing given in the changes. TEXT RULES: all text in Australian English, spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible at thumbnail size. Do NOT add any headline, badge, trust seal, star row, review, CTA pill, URL, price or logo that the reference does not have. Do NOT remove any element the reference has. OUTPUT FORMAT — ALWAYS 4:5 PORTRAIT (1080×1350), even when the reference is square or landscape (Quan 15/10/2026, never break). Keep the reference's element order and styling top to bottom, and use the extra vertical space to make the main elements BIGGER — never add new elements, never leave an empty band. 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, full-bleed edge to edge. Output ONE finished image.
